_doc: 판테온 편 v5 원화 — v4 D4 기각("거의 전구간이 전부 이전 영상들 화풍이랑 달라 실사풍에 눈은 작고") 뒤 D3 답("그냥 이전 그대로 영상 제작해주세요", "제가 중요시하는건 화풍의 일관성이에요")에 따라 전 시트 15장을 다시 그림. 참조는 channel.yaml character.refs 두 장만: 지우 기준판 refs/ch-knowledge/jiwoo_board.png + 잼 편 tasting.png. 칸 내용은 v1(garage~end)·v3(build·lime·plan) 주문 그대로, 옷만 정리(로마 = 노란 비옷·가방 없음, 주차장·골목 = 회색 코트). Codex $imagegen (-m gpt-6-sol), 원본은 Drive 영상/20261122-curiosity-pick/art/<시트>_v5.png, 프롬프트 전문 <시트>_v5.txt
common:
Create ONE wide 16:9 landscape image that is a perfect full-bleed 2x2 sheet of four separate 16:9 film frames (four equal rectangles, no gutters, no margins, no borders). Each frame is a new frame of the SAME animated film as the two attached images.

THE CHARACTER (most important): Ji-woo is the woman on the first attached image, 'jiwoo_board' - a board of panels cut directly from the finished films (eight face panels on top, four full-body panels below). Wherever Ji-woo appears, draw the SAME person in the SAME drawing method as on that board: the same face and face proportions, the same eyes, nose and mouth, the same hair (dark, softly wavy, chin-length bob with a side part and a small brown hair clip on her right side), the same adult body proportions as in the full-body panels, the same outline weight, the same colouring, the same light and the same surface texture. Do NOT make her younger, cuter or simpler than the board, and do NOT make her more realistic or more detailed than the board.

THE DRAWING METHOD (equally important): every frame - including frames without Ji-woo, the other people, the buildings, the objects and the backgrounds - is drawn as if the same artist drew more frames for the same film as the two attached images: the same dark outline weight and line quality, the same soft cel colouring with the same few light and shadow steps, the same warm gentle light, and backgrounds painted with the same level of detail as in the second attached image 'tasting'. Stone, concrete, brick, marble, metal and water are painted the way wood, shelves and cloth are painted in the attached images: soft hand-painted animation background art. No photographic or semi-realistic rendering, no photographic textures, no oil-painting look, no 3D look. Diagram-like frames are also painted in this same animation style.

CLOTHES (her face, hair and the drawing method never change): in present-day Rome and inside the Pantheon Ji-woo wears a mustard-yellow raincoat with the hood down over a grey hoodie, dark jeans and white sneakers - no backpack, no bag, no blanket. On the imagined ancient Roman building site she is a time-travelling visitor in the same mustard-yellow raincoat, plus a leather tool belt, among Roman workers in plain tunics. In the Korean underground parking garage and in the Korean street she wears a grey wool coat.

ACCURACY: the Pantheon in Rome must look architecturally correct: porch with granite columns and triangular pediment, round rotunda, interior hemispherical coffered dome with 5 rings of square recessed coffers and a round open oculus at the top, polychrome marble floor of circles and squares. The building under construction (around 120 AD) is the same round rotunda: a thick round brick-faced concrete drum and a hemispherical concrete dome built over curved wooden centering and timber scaffolding.
tail: Keep the main subject of each frame above the bottom fifth of the frame (subtitle area). Absolutely no text, letters, digits, logos, inscriptions or watermarks anywhere (inscriptions on buildings are left blank).

sheets.garage: Top left: close-up of a gray concrete ceiling in a Korean apartment underground parking garage under fluorescent light, a long jagged crack with streaks of yellow-brown rust stain running down from it, no people. Top right: the same parking garage, Ji-woo (wearing her grey wool coat) standing beside a small white car, looking up at the rust-stained crack with a puzzled frown, early morning. Bottom left: a rainy cobblestone piazza in Rome, Ji-woo in her mustard raincoat with a clear umbrella, walking toward the Pantheon porch in the distance, puddles reflecting the grey sky. Bottom right: just inside the Pantheon's huge bronze doors, Ji-woo seen from behind, umbrella lowered and dripping, stopped mid-step, head tilted up toward the vast dome interior.
sheets.dome: Top left: wide interior view of the Pantheon rotunda on a rainy day, a column of rain falling straight down through the open oculus onto the polychrome marble floor, a few tourists standing back in a circle watching, cool grey light. Top right: worm's-eye view straight up at the coffered dome, five rings of square coffers converging to the bright round oculus, raindrops falling toward the viewer. Bottom left: close-up of Ji-woo's face looking up in quiet awe, soft rainy light on her cheek, mustard raincoat hood down. Bottom right: exterior of the Pantheon in light rain seen from the side of the piazza, the low wide dome on top of the round brick rotunda, the columned porch at left, wet stone glistening.
sheets.struct: Top left: clean painted cross-section cutaway of the Pantheon dome on a dark background, the shell drawn very thick at the bottom and getting thinner toward the open oculus at the top, coffers visible on the inner surface, like a museum educational painting, no labels. Top right: close-up of the lower inner surface of an ancient concrete dome, several long thin vertical hairline cracks running upward, old plaster texture, soft side light. Bottom left: four chunks of stone resting in a row on a dark wooden museum table, from left to right getting lighter: heavy cream travertine, orange terracotta brick fragments, brownish volcanic tuff, and very porous pale grey pumice, the pumice floating in a glass bowl of water. Bottom right: close-up looking up into the square stepped coffers of the dome ceiling, deep recessed squares, raking light showing their depth.
sheets.rust: Top left: painted cutaway diagram of a modern reinforced concrete beam on a dark background, grey concrete with clean dark steel rebar rods inside, a small crack reaching in from the surface, no labels. Top right: the same cutaway later: water seeping in through the crack, the steel rebar rusted orange and swollen, the rust pushing outward and splitting the concrete, flakes breaking off. Bottom left: a modern slender concrete bridge and glass high-rise towers under construction with exposed steel rebar cages and cranes, golden hour. Bottom right: inside the rainy Pantheon, Ji-woo sitting on a bench along the wall, looking down at her smartphone (screen a plain glowing blank rectangle), thoughtful, the rain column glowing in the background.
sheets.lab: Top left: macro close-up of a broken chunk of ancient Roman concrete held in a gloved hand, grey-brown aggregate with several small bright white lumps (lime clasts) a few millimetres across embedded in it. Top right: a modern materials science laboratory, an invented middle-aged researcher in a lab coat and glasses leaning over a stereo microscope examining a small concrete fragment, curious expression, warm desk lamp. Bottom left: laboratory test setup: two small cracked concrete cylinders side by side on a stand, a thin trickle of water flowing through each crack into glass beakers below. Bottom right: the same two cylinders two weeks later: the left cylinder's crack is filled with white crystalline mineral and dry, its beaker empty; the right cylinder's crack is still open with water dripping into a half-full beaker.
sheets.history: Top left: historical reconstruction, year 609 Rome: inside the Pantheon converted into a church, a pope in white and gold vestments blessing, clergy with candles and a crowd of early medieval Romans under the dome, warm candle light. Top right: 1620s Rome: workers on wooden scaffolding under the Pantheon's columned porch roof, prying off huge ancient bronze beams with ropes and pulleys, onlookers in 17th-century clothes frowning below. Bottom left: a 17th-century foundry, molten bronze glowing orange pouring into a mold, a row of freshly cast bronze cannons, workers in leather aprons. Bottom right: centuries later, people quietly gathered under the dome for a mass, soft light from the oculus, a marble tomb niche with fresh flowers at the side.
sheets.end: Top left: close-up of the Pantheon's wet polychrome marble floor directly under the oculus after the rain, small round drain holes in the marble catching the last trickles of water, the floor gently domed so water runs outward. Top right: the rain has stopped, a beam of sunlight shines down through the oculus onto the floor, Ji-woo in her mustard raincoat standing at the edge of the light looking down at the drains, a small smile. Bottom left: painted macro cross-section of a crack inside concrete on a dark background, a white lime lump in the crack's path, water entering and white mineral crystals growing to seal the crack, gentle glowing highlights, no labels. Bottom right: dusk in an ordinary Korean neighbourhood, an old red-brick low building with a small crack on its wall, warm shop light, a few passers-by, Ji-woo (wearing her grey wool coat) walking past and glancing at it.
sheets.build1: Top left: wide sunny ancient Roman building site, Ji-woo holding a long rope tied to a wooden stake in the middle of a huge flat cleared ground, walking in a giant circle and scratching its outline into the earth, Roman workers watching, the circle so large that four ancient ox carts parked end to end fit across it. Top right: the round brick-faced drum wall already standing, a huge curved wooden centering framework of the dome rising above it on timber scaffolding, workers carrying baskets on ramps, Ji-woo on the scaffolding pointing. Bottom left: on top of the wooden centering, workers pouring and tamping grey concrete in one even layer of the same thickness all around the curved formwork, Ji-woo with a trowel smoothing it, sun and dust. Bottom right: the plain uniform dome right after the wooden formwork is removed, long vertical cracks splitting open around the lower part of the dome near its base, bits of concrete dust falling, Ji-woo below looking up in alarm with hands on her head.
sheets.build2: Top left: close-up of the base of the dome being rebuilt very thick: a massive wall of concrete many times taller than a person, Ji-woo standing beside it looking tiny, measuring with an outstretched arm, workers laying another course. Top right: exterior view of the rising dome on the round drum, workers adding a series of stepped concrete rings around the outside of the lower dome like giant stairs pressing down on its base, Ji-woo on a ladder patting the step. Bottom left: three big wicker baskets of aggregate on the building site: heavy grey-white stone chunks, broken orange bricks, and very light porous grey pumice; Ji-woo dropping a pumice stone into a wooden bucket of water where it floats, smiling in surprise. Bottom right: a warm memory flashback: a small Korean child (young Ji-woo, about 6, bob haircut) on a living-room floor stacking colourful wooden toy blocks into a tall tower, placing a big heavy block on top and the tower wobbling, soft afternoon light.
sheets.build3: Top left: under the half-built dome, workers on scaffolding pressing square stepped wooden box molds into the wet concrete of the ceiling to make deep square recessed coffers in neat rings, Ji-woo helping push one mold. Top right: the nearly finished dome seen from inside, the top left open as a large round hole to the bright sky, Ji-woo standing on high scaffolding at the hole's rim looking up through it at clouds. Bottom left: the first rain falls through the round open hole onto the new floor, workers have laid a polychrome marble floor slightly raised in the middle with a few small round drain holes right below the opening, water running outward into the drains, Ji-woo crouching to watch the water disappear. Bottom right: years later, the finished Pantheon interior, fine long vertical hairline cracks visible on the lower part of the dome above the drum, the upper dome intact, Ji-woo with her palm on the wall looking up, calm and relieved, soft light from the oculus.
sheets.lime: Top left: at the Roman concrete mixing trough, a Roman worker in a tunic tossing pale white chunks of quicklime straight into the wet mortar, a puff of hot steam rising, Ji-woo leaning back surprised. Top right: macro close-up of the steaming freshly mixed grey Roman mortar with small unmixed bright white lumps scattered through it, volcanic ash and stone fragments. Bottom left: a modern construction site at dusk, Ji-woo in a white hard hat over her raincoat beside a tall wooden column form with a dense steel rebar cage inside, a concrete pump hose pouring fresh concrete into it. Bottom right: close-up of a modern concrete column surface in a damp underground garage, a thin crack with rainwater slowly seeping into it, a faint orange rust stain starting below it, cold fluorescent light, no people.
sheets.plan1: Explanation panels: in each frame Ji-woo explains with a large hand-drawn design sketch in charcoal and red chalk on a sheet of parchment or a whitewashed wooden drafting board on the ancient Roman building site; the sketch is a simple clear cross-section drawing with bold hand-drawn arrows and shading but NO letters, NO numbers, NO words, NO measurement figures. The sketch must be large and readable in the frame, occupying about half of each frame, upper or middle part. Top left: Ji-woo on the building site holds up a huge parchment sketch: the round Pantheon rotunda in cross-section (cylinder drum topped by a hemisphere) with a perfect circle drawn inside it touching the floor and the top, as if a giant ball fits exactly inside; beside the section a tall stack of small house outlines reaching the same height, Roman workers peering at it. Top right: on a whitewashed drafting board, a cross-section of a dome of the same thin even thickness everywhere; red chalk arrows press straight down on the top of the dome and at its lower edges red arrows push outward sideways like a skirt flaring; Ji-woo beside the board spreads both hands outward showing the flare. Bottom left: close-up of Ji-woo with charcoal pointing at the lower part of the same sketched dome where she has drawn several short vertical crack lines in red; in her other hand a small clay bar pulled apart into two pieces with a crack. Bottom right: Ji-woo next to a big board sketch of an improved dome cross-section: the lower part of the dome is drawn very thick and the outside has stepped rings like a staircase around the base; three small adult human figures stand stacked head to foot beside the thick base to show its thickness, Roman builder nodding.
sheets.plan2: Explanation panels: in each frame Ji-woo explains with a large hand-drawn design sketch in charcoal and red chalk on a sheet of parchment or a whitewashed wooden drafting board on the ancient Roman building site; the sketch is a simple clear cross-section drawing with bold hand-drawn arrows and shading but NO letters, NO numbers, NO words, NO measurement figures. The sketch must be large and readable in the frame, occupying about half of each frame, upper or middle part. Top left: Ji-woo traces with her finger a dome cross-section sketch whose wall tapers smoothly from very thick at the base to thin at the top, with two double-headed red measuring arrows (one long at the bottom, one short near the top) showing the thickness. Top right: a dome cross-section sketch coloured in three horizontal bands with chalk: dark grey heavy stone at the bottom, reddish brick in the middle, very pale porous light stone at the top; Ji-woo holds a pale porous pumice stone up next to the top band, and a small bowl of water on the table with a pumice stone floating. Bottom left: on a wooden table, two stacked tower models built from blocks: one stable tower with dark heavy blocks at the bottom and pale light blocks at the top, and one upside-down tower with heavy dark blocks on top that is tipping over; Ji-woo kneels watching the falling tower, smiling. Bottom right: a drafting-board sketch of the dome seen from below and in section showing rows of square recessed hollows (coffers) carved into the inside of the dome, the hollows shaded, small red arrows showing weight removed; Ji-woo shading the hollows with charcoal.
sheets.plan3: Explanation panels: in each frame Ji-woo explains with a large hand-drawn design sketch in charcoal and red chalk on a sheet of parchment or a whitewashed wooden drafting board on the ancient Roman building site; the sketch is a simple clear cross-section drawing with bold hand-drawn arrows and shading but NO letters, NO numbers, NO words, NO measurement figures. The sketch must be large and readable in the frame, occupying about half of each frame, upper or middle part. Top left: a sketch of a dome cross-section where the whole top is drawn heavy dark grey, with big red arrows pressing down hard on the top and the base drawn bulging and cracking; Ji-woo shakes her head and draws a big red cross-out stroke over the sketch. Top right: Ji-woo with a thin wire cuts the very top off a small clay model dome on a table, leaving a round opening at the top; behind her a sketch of the dome section with the top left open. Bottom left: a sketch of the domed building in section with rain drawn as lines falling through the round opening at the top onto a floor that is drawn slightly raised in the middle, with blue chalk arrows showing water flowing to small drain holes in the floor; Ji-woo pointing at a drain hole. Bottom right: Ji-woo stands between two pinned sketches comparing them: the left one is the first failed thin dome with red outward arrows and cracks at its base, the right one is the finished thick-based dome also showing a few vertical red cracks at the bottom only; she points from one to the other.
sheets.plan4: Explanation panels: in each frame Ji-woo explains with a large hand-drawn design sketch in charcoal and red chalk on a sheet of parchment or a whitewashed wooden drafting board on the ancient Roman building site; the sketch is a simple clear cross-section drawing with bold hand-drawn arrows and shading but NO letters, NO numbers, NO words, NO measurement figures. The sketch must be large and readable in the frame, occupying about half of each frame, upper or middle part. Top left: a sketch of the finished dome cross-section: short vertical red cracks drawn only in the lower part, the upper part drawn with many small charcoal arrows pointing inward toward each other along the curve (pieces pressing on each other), and the thick base with stepped rings drawn with inward hugging arrows; Ji-woo wraps her arms in a hugging gesture beside it. Top right: inside the finished Pantheon in soft light from the oculus, Ji-woo holds her sketchbook up toward the real coffered dome, the open sketchbook shows her final section drawing (thick base, thinning roof, open top) lined up against the real dome. Bottom left: a small three-layer clay model of the dome on a table cut in half to show its section: dark layer at the bottom, brick-red layer in the middle, pale porous layer at the top, open at the very top; Ji-woo's hands holding the two halves apart. Bottom right: Ji-woo pressing two clay bars: one bar squeezed between her palms stays whole, another pulled apart by her hands snaps with a crack; simple clear gesture, workers watching curiously.
